entries.zh: 处；地方，处所（本页 lugar- 系列词头之根）
entries.en: place; spot, location (root headword of the following lugar- compounds)
entries.notes: 官话栏 geroc 与词头不相应且注音有污损（T99），据汉字'處'与西语 Lugar 立义。

entries.zh: 境；境界，地界；（司法）辖境、管辖范围
entries.en: boundary, bounds; territory, jurisdictional district (término de jurisdicción)

entries.zh: 祭坛、坛场（西注谓受难行刑之地）；字形若为'墳'则指坟茔、墓地
entries.en: altar, raised platform (Spanish gloss: place of crucifixion/execution); if the headword is 墳, grave, tomb, burial ground
entries.notes: [疑:壇/墳] 字形未定，两读分指刑坛与坟地，释义并存。

entries.zh: 位；位子，位置；尊位、职分
entries.en: seat, place; position of rank or dignity; office

entries.zh: 所；处所，地方；西注兼指村落、市镇
entries.en: place, locale; the Spanish gloss also gives 'pueblo', a village or town
entries.notes: 注音短语后两音节污损（T99），词头'所'与西语释义仍清晰。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 该条原稿已划除（[已划除]），汉字与注音各栏全空，无从立义。

entries.zh: 轴；卷轴、簿轴（西注谓记写亡者名籍之事之处，或指谱轴、神轴一类）
entries.en: scroll, roller; register-scroll bearing the records or names of the dead
entries.notes: 词头 Lug[残] 截断、注音 [疑:teg/tep]，'軸'确指存疑，姑释为书录亡者之卷轴。

entries.zh: 代；替代，顶替他人之位
entries.en: to take another's place; substitute, act in place of another
entries.notes: 注音两音节皆污损（T99），据汉字'代'与西语释义立义。

entries.zh: 空；空缺，虚位（西注谓如主教座出缺之空位）
entries.en: empty; vacant, unfilled — as a vacant see (sede vacante); vacancy

entries.zh: 下落；所在，行踪（'人/物在哪里？'）
entries.en: whereabouts; where someone or something is ('where is it?')
entries.notes: 注音两音节污损（T99），据'下落'与西语释义。

entries.zh: 密处；隐蔽、隐秘之处
entries.en: hidden, concealed place; secret spot
entries.notes: 注音有污损（T99），据'密處'与西语释义。

entries.zh: 陛下；对国王、皇帝的尊称（本义指御座阶下之地）
entries.en: Your/His Majesty — honorific for the king or emperor (lit. the place below the palace steps)
entries.notes: 注音有污损（T99）；'陛下'字面即王座阶下之地，与西语 lugar del Rey 相应。

entries.zh: 会馆；同乡、行帮聚会议事之馆所
entries.en: guild hall; meeting hall of a native-place or merchant association

entries.zh: 敝处；自谦称自己的居处、家乡（敝＝鄙薄之谦词）
entries.en: my humble place or abode; self-deprecating term for one's own home or locality
entries.notes: [疑:pi/py] 注音字形未定且有污损，据'敝處'谦称用法与西语'低贱无值之地'立义。

entries.zh: 山脉；山的脉络走势（堪舆中据山脉择吉壤作坟地）
entries.en: mountain range, mountain vein — a ridge judged favorable for siting a tomb

entries.zh: 武场；武科考场、演武校场
entries.en: military examination ground; drill field for the martial examination

entries.zh: 教场；校场，操练演武之场（西注谓士人操习之地）
entries.en: drill ground, training field (glossed as where the lettered men exercise)

entries.zh: 科场；科举试场
entries.en: examination grounds for the state (civil service) examinations

entries.zh: 贡院；举行乡试、会试的贡院考场
entries.en: examination compound (tribute hall) for the provincial and metropolitan examinations

entries.zh: 去处；所往之地、落脚之处；西注谓大邑、省会首城（两栏义不密合，并存）
entries.en: a place to go, destination, whereabouts; Spanish gloss: a large place, seat or head of a province
entries.notes: 注音有污损（T99）；'去處'（所往之地）与西语'大城、省会'义不密合，两义并存。

entries.zh: 挂澳；船只泊靠的澳湾、锚地（泊船众多之处）
entries.en: anchorage; bay or inlet where many vessels moor
entries.notes: 注音有污损（T99）；'澳'指泊船澳湾，与西语'多船之地'相合。

entries.zh: 清趣；清幽雅趣、洁净宜人的游憩之地
entries.en: pure charm, quiet delight; a clean, pleasant place of recreation
entries.notes: 注音有污损（T99），据'清趣'与西语释义。
